Script One - What is Cardano?:
Cardano is an innovative blockchain platform designed for secure and efficient digital transactions and applications. It is a sophisticated digital finance infrastructure, with a thriving and talented community of developers building tools and applications on top of it. What distinguishes Cardano from other blockchains is its dedication to environmental sustainability, scalability, and security. 
Cardano makes it simple for non-techincal users to contribute to the running of the network and validation of transactions. Users who hold its native cryptocurrency, ADA, can join collaborative groups, known as stake pools which compete to mint blocks which verify the latest transactions on the network. Stake pools are rewarded for minting blocks, and those rewards are distributed to everyone that has staked with them. Put simply, you can earn passive income for helping to secure the network, with little effort on your part.
One of the things that separates Cardano from other blockchains is that it is constructed using a ‘Functional Programming’ language called Haskell. This language is used in industries such as aerospace, defense, banking and healthcare, in mission critical systems, where precision is paramount. This enables thorough testing prior to implementation, ensuring a secure environment for tools built on top of Cardano.
